title: Keep practice apart from assessment
statement: Keep practice apart from assessment: checks during teaching give feedback and support without a mastery bar, and only a later scored assessment, with supports off, holds students to it.
example: In one demo unit, the teaching lessons' checks gave feedback without gating progress, and only the 15-item assessment kept its mastery threshold of 90.
detail: In a reading demo unit, a decision not to conflate teaching with assessment made the four teaching lessons non-gating: their checks are scored for immediate feedback but do not gate progress, and only the 15-item interval assessment keeps its 90 gate (`grade3-reading/artifacts/demo-unit-2026-07-10/phase-d/DELTA-REPORT.md`, lines 134-137; `grade3-reading/artifacts/demo-unit-2026-07-10/publish/README.md`, lines 23-25). Later lessons in the same course limited a copied pattern, one tap and one affirming clip at the end of independent work, to practice pages, never assessments (`grade3-reading/artifacts/peter-pan-standing-2026-09-11/PARITY-PLAN-2026-09-14.md`, line 12). Engagement supports are faded before that assessment.
against: Gating means different things in the course's two renderers: the book renderer's checklist makes every gate unskippable, "No trap (child can always proceed by doing the work) and no leak (cannot proceed without it)", and makes every check a gate except the first check of a unit's opening lesson (`grade3-reading/artifacts/AlphaRead-QC-Checklist-v2-2026-09-04.md`, lines 126 and 129), while the demo unit dropped the mastery threshold from its teaching lessons. The rule on support rests on one plan line. Only loosely against: whether a film belongs in such a course at all was left unresolved, one source avoiding video because the target is plain text and the course's own rules treating an opening film as essential, "a genuine, load-bearing tension" (`grade3-reading/artifacts/wiki-research/cross-cutting.md`, line 141). A later run found counter-evidence (`grade3-reading/course-renderer/docs/rules/questions-and-assessment.md`). A later run found counter-evidence (`othello-course-renderer-draft/repo/docs/rules/questions-and-assessment.md`).
